Episode 247. Liberation War of Laprarosa (7)
'This is the Plutonian Domination Sword...!'
Shimat had already experienced Jin's
Plutonian Domination Sword once before. It was back when, before Shimat's awakening, he and Rakiman had attacked the seven regions of Kinzelo.
However, the fierce lightning energy unfolding before Shimat's eyes now was forming a storm far more intense than before.
'It's different. It's incomparably stronger than back then...!'
The red waves energy were fading.
The red fleet was already disappearing, engulfed by the blue lightning of the Plutonian Domination Sword. The shields or armors of regular fleets meant nothing before that sword.
The air heated like lava, the light burning the retinas.
Only Shimat and the four aerial fortresses managed to withstand it without melting, breaking, or scattering in the midst of it.
The fortresses rapidly distanced themselves, and Shimat reflexively backed away, trying to get out of Jin's range.
But no place was safe. Everywhere the eye could see, even the farthest reaches, was filled with the light of the Plutonian Domination Sword.
Stumbling backward, looking back, then forward again, confronting the fear inside, trying to restrain his legs that kept meaninglessly trying to flee.
“Ha.”
Suddenly, Shimat let out a hollow laugh.

The emptiness of everything being over, the feeling of defeat that he could never win, the loss of hope for survival he had barely obtained after enduring that great ordeal, and the awe for a power beyond comprehension...
All these emotions intertwined and a fire raged inside his head.
However, Shimat didn't let despair consume him.
He struggled against it. Even if there wasn't the slightest possibility in sight, he couldn't just lie down defeated like a scared dog.
Thus, Shimat tried to see.
The fighting spirit that surely remained somewhere in the gap between despair and frustration. The emotion he had become too familiar with since reaching Genesis.
"All aerial fortresses should disengage support for me and focus on body defense and striking Laprarosa."
It wasn't communication through the bracelet, but a low voice filled with energy. That voice pierced through the loud sounds of the lightning and resonated in the ears of all on the battlefield.
That too is the power of Genesis.
A power only those who have overcome even the most difficult fate and seized such a possibility can reach.
The red wave energy that was blocking Shimart's surroundings like a wall was fading. And then, finally, with a face fully emerging from the haze, Shimart confronted Jin.
"Yes, that seems right. We shouldn't have meddled with you. But what can we do? We were born this way. Since birth, we've known nothing but fighting, destruction, and conquest, Jin Runkandel."
It was a voice he was hearing for the first time, one that felt sincere.

Both Jin and Ban, having combined their souls, resonated with that voice. Jin was also born into the Lunkandel family, a family of warriors, and Ban, as a member of the Plutonian, had always lived the life of a conqueror.

[I know. But the end for such people is always the same, Shimat. Whether they conquer and rule the world, they break eventually. Either when meeting a stronger opponent like now or simply fragmenting with time.]
Shimat immediately recognized that it was Ban's voice.
Without the support of the airborne fortress, Shimat couldn't fight gracefully. It was hard to believe that not long ago, he was the figure who held the most power on the ground.
Rolling on the ground, swinging his sword wildly to fend off the surging energy.
Yet, to Jin and Ban, he seemed even more genuine in this form, not just a monster engrossed in raw ambition.
[I too had such a time. After our defeat in the past great war, we became trapped inside this dimension. But we met a savior named Jin.]
"Haha! Is that so? With such incomprehensible power, did you really need a savior, Battle God of Laprarosa?"
[Everyone needs salvation once they are born.]
"We never had the chance to meet such a savior. But even if we did, we wouldn't have taken it. Because that's not the life of our clan."

[Then prove it. Prove that your way of life is right. But you will fail. Relying solely on power, you can never reach your destination, as the examples here show. You are not stronger than me, Shimat. And the right of Genesis is not omnipotent.]
Kraaaah!
Shimat roared and raised his weapon. In the meantime, the thunderous energy rushed at him like a demon, tearing at his body.
Flesh and blood splattered. At this rate, Shimat's physical form seemed to be on the verge of vanishing.
But Jin and Ban were sure that the more Shimat was cornered, the stronger he would become. He was barely protecting his vital points while raising the thunderous energy in his heart.
Jin was also unleashing his great sword in sync.

Plutonian Dominantion Sword - Past
The second decision of the Battle God secret technique
Its power even reached the brothers suffering in Laprarosa. Crossing dimensions, it was the marching song of the Plutonians.
All their will was converging into Jin's heart.
Not only the red waves energy but also the chaos that was eroding the battlefield now seemed to retreat, avoiding the surge of energy.
Simultaneously, the movements of the airborne fortresses that were loading their cannons inside the protective barrier came to a halt.
Even Pibil, who had just finished loading and was firing its cannon at Laprarosa, was completely frozen in place.
The cannon fired towards Lafrarosa appeared to be frozen in mid-air, stuck in its trajectory.
It was the same sword that had even halted Ram's attacks during the Evil God War. The same scene was unfolding once again on the battlefield.
The only one moving freely within this frozen battlefield was Jin.
And the only sound echoing was the thunder of the Plutonian Dominantion Sword.
[You cannot surpass us, Shimat.]
Countless thunders ripped through the azure sky. Wherever the Battle God thunder fell, a loud explosion followed by a sharp slicing sound erupted.
It was the sound of the aerial fortresses being sliced. Huge azure blades falling from the sky were ravaging the four aerial fortresses.
The protective shield was meaningless.
Shields formed by mechanical devices, without any will or intent, could never block the Battle God lightning.
Especially when the Battle Kings, who were supposed to protect the airborne fortresses, were fighting outside, the lightning struck mercilessly.
The Red Plutonian was crumbling.
The four airborne fortresses they took pride in were being shattered without resistance. At this rate, within less than 5 minutes, they'd be completely obliterated.
Swish!
Once again, Shimat's sword lunged towards Jin's neck. His heavily wounded and bloodied body momentarily obscured Jin's vision.
"No! We will transcend, even if we eventually break, even if we die, even if our entire fate is denied! All of that will come after surpassing you!"
From the moment Shimat s
wung his sword again, the airborne fortresses began to move.
Thanks to him denting the waves of the Plutonian Dominant Sword. The blade of the Tetallon left a red afterimage in Jin's domain.
Some of the wounds on Shimat's body were so deep that the bones were visible.
However, Jin and Ban could see it. Even if the wounds kept deepening, leaving only bones or even if nothing remained, Shimat would continue swinging his sword.
'Taking a life is easy, but killing one's will isn't. In that sense... He is indeed a worthy opponent, dear brother Jin.'
Shimat's sword strikes kept grazing Jin's body.
Yet not a single strike managed to go deep. Although the energy of the Red Divine Sword permeated through the wounds into the flesh, it couldn't penetrate the heart's light.
Every single cell, every strand of blood vessel was filled with Jin and the Battle God lightning energy. The Red Sea had threatened Laprarosa only because Ban and the brothers had to be protected.
Click-!

The middle and ring fingers of Shimat, holding the Tetalon, exploded. Losing a finger or two might not affect his swordsmanship or will, but it's inevitable that the already closing door gets sealed even tighter.
The threshold for surpassing was becoming increasingly higher. All Jin needed to break Shimat's will was just enough time.
The gap had always been vast from the beginning.

"Abandon the defense, retrieve all the power used for the protective barrier! Focus all power on the attack. Even if we lose all four of our aerial fortresses, Laprarosa must be destroyed at all costs!"
Inside the aerial fortress, Limagas shouted.
He was regretting his decision. He wanted to kill himself for directly advising Shimat not to use the Kri.
'I should have brought the Kri before this happened. Using the witch? That was nonsense. Rather, the witch used us! The witch wanted Laprarosa to be freed... to destroy the Kri!'
Kri, and the Light of Annihilation.
Limagas was certain that the witch aimed for that. The light of annihilation would undoubtedly be the most dangerous factor for the witch herself in any situation.
Even with this realization, it was too late now.
Lafrarosa was on the verge of being freed, and their Battle God, although not yet fully released, was already exerting a terrible influence.
It was far too late to correct the mistakes.

It's hard to imagine, but even if Shimat defeated Jin, the Red Plutonian would have nothing left. Their comrades, including the Battle God, would all be dead or worse, and the aerial fortresses and fleets would be unusable.
In essence, the only option they had now was to self-destruct. Going down while causing the maximum damage to the enemy was the best they could hope for.
"Is there still no word from the Kri!?"
Limagas had called for the Kri the moment when the Battle God fusion began. Because of the wave energy, communication was impossible, so he sent a part of the fleet.

However, it seemed those who went to summon the Kri were probably dead. Amidst the immense energy that was tearing apart the aerial fortresses, the great Battle Kings, and even Shimat, could they have safely escaped the desert?
Limagas lowered his head. The crew members, who should have responded to what he just shouted, were being swallowed and disappeared by the blue energy.
The energy from the Plutonian Domination Sword began to penetrate Pibil's armor and enter the inside. Limagas watched helplessly, his face hollow, as the ruined bridge's armor was pierced.
Among the Red Plutonian, only Shimat was moving forward, pushing through the despair, towards Jin. Even if it seemed like a futile effort.
